task_text: Close the lid of the thermal cycler and lock it: the lid swung fully down (1.9 rad from where it stands open) and the lever on the lid turned to the locked end of its travel (0.94 rad). Success the moment both are within 0.01 rad of those end positions.

inventory: thermal cycler (Bio-Rad C1000 model) with a hinged lid, a locking lever on the lid and a force knob
